tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per terms and condition of Tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a manufacturer /authorized supplier of reputed manufacturing firm and should have a minimum experience of 5 years in designing, manufacturing, testing and supply of the equipments of similar rating capacity to the ones specified and being offered. (Bidders have to furnish the supporting Documents)

The firm/supplier should have Manufactured and supplied at least 50 percent of the quantity of tendered material to KPTCL ESCOMs in any of the last five years as on the date of the bid opening. Enclosed the documentary evidence with PO copies.
The Bidder shall furnish the performance certificates issued by state Electricity Utilities only & issuing officer shall not be below the rank Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Bidder should be approved vendor of KPTCL ESCOMs list.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Letter of undertaking certificate for no Litigation, Blacklisting and No Deviation. Documentary proof wherever required shall be uploaded. No hard copies will be accepted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The offer of the bidders taking deviations in following clauses will be summarily rejected. Validity of offer, Stipulated Delivery Schedule, Earnest Money Deposit, Payment terms, Price Basis, Bidders past performance, Guarantee, Penalty for delay supply,Change in offered quantity against tendered quantity, Contract Performance Security or BG.

Financial capability corresponding to the bidders Annual Turnover of the best of one year of preceding 3 years shall not be less than 185.02 lakhs(2 times the APT), the same shall be Audited and duly signed by Chartered Accountant and submit at the time of Bid submission.
